text.text_excerpt: This place was a gem to find not too far from our hotel. I came here for breakfast with a friend when visiting NOLA. There was a long wait, but plenty of shops we could check out nearby while we waited. They text you when your table is just about ready, so you can actually leave and shop while you wait. The staff was so friendly and helpful, great service! Even though they were busy, service was amazing and quick. I also did not feel rushed at all, which I appreciate when a restaurant is crowded and there is a wait for a table. My friend had the Avocado omelette, which looked and tasted delicious (of course I had a bite!) and she loved it! I had the two egg platter with grits. My eggs cam...

We just arrived in New Orleans after a tiring red eye flight, and we were starving for some breakfast. Good old yelp came to the rescue and we found Cafe Fleur De Lis in walking distance. The place is jammed packed on a Friday morning, and the line takes forever. Speed is definitely not their forte here. But everyone's food looked so good, that we decided to wait it out. Omg the pancakes here are so delish!! I guess I don't order pancakes frequently, but this was miles better than what i've had at Stacks or IHOP back at home. So buttery, so yummy. I also loved the hash browns. YUM! Everything else was your standard breakfast fare, but overall I was satisfied and happy.

I had read positive reviews for this place, so I decided that I would have breakfast here one day during my visit. I had one of mall-time favorite meals (during my entire trip) at Café Fleur De Lis. I went here for breakfast one day and had their shrimp and grits. Now I tasted shrimp and grits all over the French Quarter, and this place had my absolute favor dish. The butter and shallots made for an amazing "gravy" for these grits. Many of the shrimp and grit dishes that I had were barbeque, so I enjoyed that this dish was not like that.
